extracted.title: The Importance of Technology in Modern Education
key_points: Technology has transformed modern education through online classes, digital libraries, and educational apps.
It provides flexibility, allowing students to learn from anywhere and at any time.
Online platforms enhance communication between teachers and students for assignments and discussions.
Interactive tools like videos and presentations make learning more engaging.
Challenges include internet connectivity issues and concerns over excessive screen time.
Technology makes education more effective, interactive, and accessible for everyone.
